candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) guard so users can overwrite an existing guess.
Change the ether requirement from 1 ether to 2 ether so calls with 1 ether revert.
Delete the statement storing the guess hash, leaving guesses[msg.sender].guess as bytes32(0).
Store block.number instead of block.number + 1 as the target block, changing which block hash is later checked.
Store hash of the block.number rather than the stored guess value, altering later settlement comparison.
